payload.summary: Split the largest front-end files (ClinicalDashboard ~4,000 lines, MasterSearchHeader ~3,200, globals.css ~6,000) into smaller owned modules
payload.detail: Found in the 2026-09-27 design review (PR #3145 session). Their size makes every UI change fragile and slow to review. Owner chose not to rebuild them in that pass. Do one file per careful PR, behaviour-neutral, with verify:phone-chrome and the full browser suite; globals.css splits must preserve cascade order (unlayered component CSS by design).
payload.source: Claude Code session 2026-09-27 phone-first design review (PR #3145)
